title: HTMLDialogElement show can put disconnected dialogs in the open dialogs list.
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

Step 8 of [`show()`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-dialog-show):

> Add [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)'s [open dialogs list](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#open-dialogs-list).

At no point prior does `show()` assert or guard the document being connected. This can result in a _disconnected_ dialog being in the open dialogs list. Removing `open` and calling `show()` again will hit the assert on Step 7, which if implemented precisely would cause a crash.

```js
let d = document.createElement('dialog');
d.show() // In the open dialogs list!
d.open = false;
d.show() // Assert fails!
```

The reason this fails is because Dialog has no attribute changed steps to _remove_ a Dialog from the open dialogs list. This is solved by https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10954 which aligns the behaviour closer to Chrome.

Chrome's impl is divergent from the spec because Chrome's flow goes something like:

1. [Show() sets `open` attribute](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/core/html/html_dialog_element.cc;l=432)
2. [AttributeChangedSteps fire on Element, calling ParseAttribute](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/core/dom/element.cc;l=3132-3133)
3. [HTMLDialogElement::ParseAttribute](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/core/html/html_dialog_element.cc;l=763) checks if the `open` attribute is being added, _and the element is connected_.
4. [Then do step 8](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/core/html/html_dialog_element.cc;l=768-769).

/cc @lukewarlow @mfreed7
